symptom: check flagged `trim($v) != empty` (E015) but said nothing about `$v != empty and trim($v) != ''`, whose empty half is dead (ako/mxcli#2566, mendixlabs/mxcli#1937).
cause: E015 looks at one comparison against `empty`; it deliberately skips the and-ed idiom (chainComparesWithBlank) and nothing judged the chain as a whole.
fix: Per and-chain (or-chain with =): a `<x> != empty` operand, <x> a variable or attribute path, beside `f(<x>, …) != ''` with f in neverEmptyStringFuncs is E016 (info, redundant). The issue's second shape, `<x> != empty and <x> != ''` (spaces pass), is not reported.
insight: Judge an idiom at the chain level (flattenChain + exprKey). The second shape the issue asked for (E017) was built and then dropped: CI's describe round trip over Studio Pro-authored FeedbackModule (exprcheck_roundtrip_test, integration tag) holds expression hints to zero, and E017 fired five times there — on base64 strings and ids, where spaces do not matter and nothing in the expression says otherwise. Run the integration round trip before adding any hint; a rule's noise on Marketplace code is the cost that decides it. It also caught the guarded operand being a call (trim(x) != empty and trim(x) != ''), now excluded.
test: mdl/exprcheck/blank_guard_2566_test.go (6 E016 shapes, controls incl. the not-reported `$v != empty and $v != ''` and a guarded call); executor exprcheck_roundtrip_test (integration): 0 hints on FeedbackModule after, 5 E017 before
